economics.owner_net_profit_potential: $30,000–$480,000 USD annually, before personal taxes and reinvestment
economics.includes_contractors_note: Headcount includes the working owner and recurring contractors as people, not FTE equivalents. Contractors may be part-time. Scaled scenario adds one employee and one contractor; external vendor workforces are not counted as internal team members.
economics.revenue_basis: Gross billable inbound call & RTB ping-post exchange settlements (55% retained net spread after publisher payouts & click-to-call media)
economics.cost_basis: Annual net margins include operating expenses and non-owner labor; monthly opex is fixed/semi-fixed overhead only. No owner salary is deducted. Capital needs may grow beyond startup range.
economics.estimate_status: Illustrative assumptions; not verified earnings data

conservative.assumption: Illustrative established-operation run rate, not first-year earnings. Margin includes operating costs and non-owner labor; owner labor is not separately compensated. Scale requires additional demand, working capital and delivery capacity.

base_case.assumption: Illustrative established-operation run rate, not first-year earnings. Margin includes operating costs and non-owner labor; owner labor is not separately compensated. Scale requires additional demand, working capital and delivery capacity.

scaled_small_team.assumption: Illustrative established-operation run rate, not first-year earnings. Margin includes operating costs and non-owner labor; owner labor is not separately compensated. Scale requires additional demand, working capital and delivery capacity.

automation_levers: AI transcript disposition & S2S ad-bid postbacks
regulatory_notes: Enforce FCC TCPA one-to-one written consent, CMS Medicare TPMO 48-hour/call-recording rules, and state bar legal-advertising/runner prohibitions.
Scrub DNC/litigator lists in real time and cap publisher traffic until net-7 buyer collectability is verified.

inputs: Authorized inbound traffic sources, accurate ads and landing pages, versioned recipient-specific disclosures, TrustedForm or Jornaya evidence where applicable, suppression records and permitted recording notices.

Ringba or Retreaver configuration, documented buyer ping-post endpoints, buyer authorization or licensing checks, vertical-specific eligibility rules, capacities and payout terms including any 90–120-second duration threshold.
Traffic cost data, call-detail records, transfer and consent events, buyer acceptance receipts, duplicate identifiers, dispute reason codes and restricted-access retention settings.
plays.mechanism: Use Ringba or Retreaver-supported routing and buyer integrations to auction qualified inbound calls through sub-second ping-post trees, earning the spread between accepted buyer payouts and traffic acquisition costs. Operate separate programs for ACA/Medicare, auto/home insurance, mass-tort legal intake and emergency home services, with recipient-specific consent where required, sector-specific transfer restrictions and privacy-minimized bid payloads. TrustedForm or Jornaya records can support evidence of the actual named-recipient disclosure but do not independently establish valid consent; negotiated 90–120-second duration triggers qualify payment only alongside genuine caller intent, buyer acceptance and applicable contract terms.
metrics: Net contribution per qualified call: collected buyer revenue minus acquisition, telephony, routing, verification and refund costs.
Routing quality: p95 auction latency, accepted-connection rate, abandonment rate and buyer capacity rejection rate by vertical.
Evidence and dispute quality: percentage of transfers with required recipient-specific permission records, duplicate rate, complaint rate and payout reversal rate.
plays.name: Consent-Verified Inbound RTB Pay-Per-Call Exchange Operator

platform_risks.detection_metric: Consent-recipient mismatch count, complaint and reversal rates by source, and anomalous clustering of call endings immediately after the billing threshold.
platform_risks.failure_mode: A buyer or routing platform rejects calls or suspends the program because consent, marketing representations or traffic quality fails applicable requirements.
platform_risks.fallback: Stop affected sources and transfers, preserve evidence securely, refund invalid billings and resume only with corrected disclosures, permitted compensation structures and verified buyer acceptance.
platform_risks.impact: Payout reversals, account suspension, consumer complaints and potential regulatory or contractual exposure.
platform_risks.trigger: Recipient mismatches, misleading ACA/Medicare advertising, restricted legal-referral fee structures, excessive duplicates or calls padded to cross a duration threshold.

workflow: 1. Approve legitimate traffic sources and buyer contracts, segregate verticals, and establish how each caller receives accurate recipient disclosures without misleading benefit claims or prohibited steering.

2. Screen intent, geography, duplicates and applicable transfer restrictions; obtain required permission before transmitting personal information and send only permitted minimal qualification metadata in bid requests.

3. Run the supported sub-second auction with timeouts and capacity checks, identify the selected recipient and obtain any required recipient-specific permission before transfer, then connect the caller without artificially extending duration.
4. Reconcile buyer acceptance and any 90–120-second billing condition against call records, resolve disputes, suppress invalid sources and settle only genuine, contract-qualified calls.

plays.name: Rank-and-Rent Digital Real Estate & Pay-Per-Call Routing
plays.mechanism: Build and rank local high-ticket service hubs (foundation repair, water restoration, probate liquidation, commercial roofing) wired to dynamic call-tracking switches (Ringba / Twilio) that auto-bill local operators $75–$300 per inbound call lasting over 90 seconds.
inputs: City + high-ticket emergency/specialty service domain portfolio
Ringba / Twilio dynamic number insertion (DNI) & IVR duration billing switch
Co-verified local contractor partner agreements with card-on-file auto-recharge
workflow: Launch fast programmatic local service pages and cost calculators for high-ticket, high-urgency verticals ($5,000+ average job ticket)
Partner with a licensed brick-and-mortar operator in each city for legitimate Google Business Profile co-verification while retaining ownership of the domain and tracking numbers
Route inbound prospect calls through Ringba with a 90-second duration threshold, automatically charging the partner's card on file per qualified call
metrics: Inbound calls per site per month & % of calls >90 seconds
Revenue per qualified call ($75–$300) and contractor retention rate
Portfolio gross margin (80–90% once ranked)

platform_risks.failure_mode: Google Business Profile suspension or contractor payment default
platform_risks.trigger: Registering fake Google Maps pins at UPS stores/virtual offices or delivering calls before collecting prepaid credit balances
platform_risks.impact: Loss of Map Pack call volume or uncollected call receivables
platform_risks.detection_metric: Organic-vs-Maps call split and prepaid Stripe wallet balance per partner
platform_risks.fallback: Anchor traffic in organic city/calculator pages (immune to GBP suspension), co-verify Maps only with real partner physical addresses, and enforce prepaid auto-refill call wallets

plays.name: Social-to-Search Ad Feed & Ping-Post Lead Arbitrage
plays.mechanism: Buy $0.05–$0.12 curiosity clicks on Meta, TikTok, NewsBreak, and native ad networks and route them through a 4-question qualification bridge—replacing fragile $1.50 RSOC/AFD search-feed clicks with direct $45–$180 Ping-Post lead auctions.
inputs: Low-CPC social/native ad hooks ($0.05–$0.12 CPC)
Fast 4-question conditional qualification quiz + TCPA consent capture
Real-time Ping-Post lead distribution engine (Boberdoo / Leadspedia / Phonexa) + RSOC downsell feed
workflow: Acquire low-cost social and native clicks using compliant consumer-benefit hooks (tax appeals, solar rebates, insurance audits, surplus claims)
Pre-qualify zip code, homeowner/business status, and urgency inside a zero-friction 4-step quiz bridge
Auction verified exclusive leads in real time via Ping-Post for $45–$180/lead and monetize non-qualifying traffic via compliant secondary search/affiliate offers
metrics: Effective media cost per qualified lead (CPL) vs. Ping-Post auction payout
Ping-to-Post acceptance rate (%) and sub-500ms auction response time
Net arbitrage margin after ad spend and buyer returns

platform_risks.failure_mode: Ad-account ban, RSOC/AFD feed termination, or TCPA consent challenge
platform_risks.trigger: Using fake 'government stimulus' ad bait, forcing accidental ad clicks, or selling leads without one-to-one TCPA consent logs
platform_risks.impact: Ad account suspension, feed clawbacks, or buyer lead rejections
platform_risks.detection_metric: Ad disapproval rate, buyer return rate >5%, and TrustedForm/Jornaya certificate match rate (100% required)
platform_risks.fallback: Enforce 100% factual ad hooks, log cryptographic TrustedForm/Jornaya session certificates on every form submit, and diversify across 5+ direct lead buyers

plays.name: TCPA Serial-Plaintiff Docket Scraping & Real-Time Litigator-Scrub Firewall Tollbooth
plays.mechanism: Offer consent-first outbound compliance screening using lawful docket-derived risk signals alongside mandatory do-not-call and revocation checks; plaintiff matching neither authorizes contact nor replaces TCPA compliance.
inputs: Permitted public docket data with identity confidence scores
Consent provenance, revocations, and suppression lists
Applicable calling rules and customer retention policies
workflow: 1. Ingest permitted docket records with source dates, minimization, and human identity review
2. Check consent, do-not-call status, revocations, and calling restrictions before optional risk enrichment
3. Suppress noncompliant contacts and route uncertain matches to review without planting honeypots or provoking claims
4. Serve auditable screening decisions with correction, deletion, and retention controls
metrics: Contacts blocked for missing consent or suppression match
False-positive identity match rate
Screening latency and stale-record share

platform_risks.failure_mode: False identity match or false assurance of permission to call
platform_risks.trigger: Stale docket data or treating absence from a plaintiff list as consent
platform_risks.impact: Unlawful outreach, privacy complaints, and customer liability
platform_risks.detection_metric: Consent-audit failure rate and upheld identity correction requests
platform_risks.fallback: Disable uncertain enrichment and require independently verified consent and authoritative suppression checks

plays.name: Multi-Location Google Business Profile (GBP) Local-Pack Grid Arbitrage
plays.mechanism: Capture high-margin Google Maps 3-Pack calls across tier-2/3 metros by partnering with real, licensed local tradespeople to co-verify legitimate physical office/shop locations, wiring call-tracking numbers and review-automation workflows to monetize excess lead capacity.
inputs: Geo-grid rank tracker identifying low-review-count Map Pack gaps in $3k+ home/commercial verticals
Joint-venture co-verification agreements with real brick-and-mortar licensed contractors
Dynamic call routing (Ringba) + automated SMS post-job review velocity loop
workflow: Identify suburban and tier-2 metro sub-markets where top-3 Google Maps competitors have <40 reviews and weak category optimization
Sign a revenue-share or pay-per-call partnership with a real local contractor or commercial office tenant (never using fake UPS boxes or virtual coworking addresses)
Optimize GBP primary/secondary categories, service-area pages, and automated customer review requests to lock top-3 Map Pack placement and bill per qualified call
metrics: Local Geo-Grid Top-3 share of voice (%)
Qualified inbound Map Pack calls per location per month
Net revenue per location ($1,500–$6,000/mo) and partner retention

platform_risks.failure_mode: Google Business Profile video-verification failure or network-wide account suspension
platform_risks.trigger: Creating fake storefront listings at UPS stores, virtual offices, or residential addresses without signage/licensing
platform_risks.impact: Immediate GBP suspension and loss of all accumulated reviews and Map Pack calls
platform_risks.detection_metric: 100% physical signage, utility bill, and state contractor license verification readiness per profile
platform_risks.fallback: Only launch GBP profiles backed by a real partner's physical shop/yard capable of passing live video verification, and pair every listing with organic city rank-and-rent pages

plays.name: Paid-to-Organic Media Arbitrage

High-RPM / high-CPL monetization endpoints
Cohort ROAS & LTV attribution ledger

Segment incoming visitors via instant qualification prompts to route high-value leads to premium buyers
Recycle organic search and newsletter return visits at zero marginal media cost

Realized RPM minus effective CPC
Lead acceptance rate

plays.name: Ad-Library Spend-Velocity & Funnel-Clone Arbitrage
plays.mechanism: Continuously poll Meta Ad Library, Google Ads Transparency Center, and TikTok Creative Center to detect direct-response creatives kept active >30 days with expanding variant counts, then localize or adapt the proven funnel architecture into untapped verticals and geos.

Ad-longevity (>30 days active) & creative-variant velocity scoring model
Rapid landing-page localization & multi-geo media buying desk

Isolate offers scaling for 30+ consecutive days (proving positive unit economics) and map their quiz/pre-sell mechanics
Deploy original, localized pre-sell funnels in lower-CPM geographies or adjacent B2B verticals—or sell the curated winning-ad intelligence feed to agencies

Cross-geo CPM/CPC discount vs. US baseline (%)
Return on ad spend (ROAS) and intelligence-subscription MRR

Earnings per click (EPC) on switching-intent queries
Organic top-3 SERP share across '[Competitor] pricing/alternative' clusters

plays.name: Arizona ABS Law-Firm Ownership & Survivor/Mass-Tort Co-Counsel Arbitrage
plays.mechanism: Leverage Arizona Supreme Court Rule 31.1(c) and ACJA § 7-209 (which abolished ABA Rule 5.4 in Arizona via Alternative Business Structure [ABS] licensing) so non-lawyer acquisition operators can legally own an Arizona law firm, acquire inbound institutional sexual assault survivor claims (juvenile detention facilities, rideshare MDLs, clergy/boarding-school/medical lookback windows) and catastrophic mass torts, and participate in lawful co-counsel contingency fee splits ($50k–$400k+ per settled case) instead of capped flat marketing fees.
inputs: Arizona Supreme Court ABS license + designated Compliance Lawyer (ACJA § 7-209)
Trauma-informed inbound acquisition funnels for state sexual-assault lookback windows & federal MDLs
24/7 HIPAA-compliant survivor intake, facility/ride-receipt verification, & national trial co-counsel network
workflow: Form or partner with a licensed Arizona ABS law firm with an appointed Arizona-bar Compliance Lawyer to legally bridge digital acquisition and legal representation
Run empathetic, 100% inbound survivor-advocacy campaigns across open statutory lookback windows (juvenile detention centers, Uber/Lyft rideshare MDL 3084, institutional/youth-facility abuse)

Execute trauma-informed intake, verify facility/detention/rideshare records, and co-counsel with specialized trial litigators under Rule 1.5(e) joint-responsibility agreements to share in back-end settlement fees
metrics: Cost per signed & record-verified survivor retainer ($1,200–$3,500 media cost)
Facility/rideshare corroboration pass rate (%) & zero-fraud docket quality
Realized co-counsel contingency fee per settled case ($50,000–$400,000+ vs. $3k lead sale)

platform_risks.failure_mode: Cross-jurisdictional Rule 5.4 fee-splitting challenges, MDL claimant-fraud rejections, or 24–48 month settlement lockup
platform_risks.trigger: Splitting fees in non-ABS jurisdictions without genuine legal services/joint responsibility by ABS attorneys, accepting unverified lead-brokered retainers, or undercapitalizing multi-year MDL hold times
platform_risks.impact: Disallowance of co-counsel fee division in restrictive states, court dismissal of uncorroborated claims, or working-capital exhaustion before settlement payout
platform_risks.detection_metric: 100% primary-record corroboration rate (detention/medical/ride logs) and state-by-state Rule 1.5(e)/5.4 ethics opinion sign-off
platform_risks.fallback: Ensure licensed ABS attorneys perform substantive legal intake/case-work or pair with an MSO (Management Services Organization) structure in restrictive states, enforce strict primary-document verification before filing, and blend fast-settling single-event injury cases with multi-year institutional dockets

plays.name: Litigation-Finance Mass-Tort Lead-to-Docket Securitization & Co-Counsel Syndicates
plays.mechanism: Pairing an Arizona Alternative Business Structure (ABS) or co-counsel law firm with an institutional litigation-finance credit facility to acquire, medically verify (via $6.50 HITECH patient-directed record requests), and package 1,000–25,000 retained mass-tort plaintiffs (PFAS, AFFF, Paraquat, NEC, rideshare assault, defective medical devices) at $1,200–$2,500 CAC—either flipping vetted case tranches to litigation-finance hedge funds at 2.5x–4x cost or holding for 35–40% global MDL settlement fee splits.
inputs: Judicial Panel on Multidistrict Litigation (JPML) docket analytics, FDA FAERS adverse-event spikes, and EPA contaminant zip-code maps
Arizona ABS / co-counsel retainer infrastructure with e-sign intake and automated HITECH Act (45 CFR § 164.524) medical-record retrieval engine
Non-recourse litigation-finance warehouse credit facility and MDL leadership co-counsel placement contracts
workflow: Identify emerging MDL mass torts with clear causation biomarkers (specific ICD-10 diagnosis codes + geographic/product exposure proof) and deep-pocket corporate defendants
Run hyper-targeted CTV, paid social, and public-record outbound campaigns to sign injured claimants directly onto joint co-counsel retainer agreements

Execute automated HITECH patient-directed electronic medical record (EMR) pulls at the federal statutory cap (~$6.50/record) and use LLM clinical parsers to verify qualifying diagnosis and exposure dates within 72 hours

Securitize verified, deficiency-free case tranches into litigation-finance buyout facilities at $4,500–$9,000 per vetted retainer or hold on the balance sheet for $25,000–$80,000+ gross contingency fees at MDL settlement

HITECH medical-record retrieval turnaround time (hours) and clinical qualification pass rate (%)
Secondary docket tranche sale multiple (2.5x–4.0x CAC) or net MDL settlement IRR

plays.name: Commercial Hail-Swath Public Adjuster & Appraisal-Clause Storm Arbitrage
plays.mechanism: Match verified commercial storm damage with licensed public-adjuster capacity and policy-specific appraisal processes, distinguishing valuation disputes from coverage questions.
inputs: Public hail-swath data and property records
Policy forms and dated damage inspections
State licensing, solicitation, and fee-limit rules
workflow: 1. Map storm footprints to commercial properties and conduct permitted owner outreach
2. Obtain authorized inspections and licensed review of coverage, deadlines, and preexisting damage

metrics: Verified covered-loss rate
Days from inspection to resolved valuation
Net client proceeds after fees and deductible

platform_risks.failure_mode: Unauthorized adjusting or inapplicable appraisal demand

Publisher co-op SHA-256 HEM spine + County Assessor / B2B LinkedIn enrichment graph

Route resolved B2B executives to instant Slack/LinkedIn warm outreach, trigger physical next-day postcards to resolved homeowner addresses, and sync SHA-256 hashes into Meta/Google Custom Audiences

Cost per resolved identity ($0.10–$0.25) vs. net recovered revenue per 1,000 bounces
Postcard & B2B LinkedIn intercept conversion rate (%)
